ui.saves.conflict_description: The saves changed on this device and in the cloud since they were last synced. The saves you don’t keep are replaced.
ui.saves.conflict_title: Which saves of “{title}” do you want to keep?
ui.notify.failed_start_body: Open Ember to see what went wrong.
ui.engine.missing: “{title}” plays with {engine}, which isn’t on this computer yet. Ember can download it from its project and start the game.
ui.engine.core_missing: {engine} needs its {core} core for this game, and Ember couldn’t download it. Check your connection and try again.
ui.engine.version_missing: “{title}” is set to use {engine} {version}, which was removed. Play with the version {engine} uses by default, or install that version again on the Emulators page.
ui.engine.manage_hint: You can choose another emulator for this game with “Play with…”.
ui.engine.installing_detail: The game starts when it’s ready.
ui.engine.bios: {system} games need a startup file from your own console, called a BIOS. Choose the folder where you keep it; any of these files will do:
ui.engine.bios_never: Ember never downloads BIOS files. They are copyrighted and must come from a console you own.
